name: PulpGrit Style
description: PulpGrit [Z-Image Turbo] PulpGrit is a style LoRA trained on Z-Image Turbo , designed to infuse your generations with a raw, weathered, dark fantasy aesthetic. It bridges the gap between retro pulp comic covers and high-contrast oil paintings, adding heavy atmosphere and a distinct "gritty" texture to your images. This model is trigger-less . The style is baked into the model's weights, so you don't need a specific keyword—simply describe your scene, and the style will apply naturally. Recommended Strength: 0.6 to 0.8 Example Prompt a cinematic medium shot of an orc warrior with weathered skin and scarred armor, holding a heavy battleaxe, illuminated by harsh side lighting against a dark moody background, high contrast, pulp art style
